decisions.quote: These findings represent a partial replication of Janiszewski and Uy (2008). The central claim of their paper – that anchor precision influences the degree of adjustment was supported. Additionally, these data replicated the main effect of motivation observed in their study. There was no evidence of the reported interaction.
decisions.reason: The author explicitly characterizes the overall result as a partial replication, supporting the main effects of anchor precision and motivation while finding no evidence of the predicted interaction.
